bio.text: N'Kiyla Jasmine Thomas is the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in Oklahoma in the November 3, 2026 general election, after winning the August 25 runoff against Jim Priest.
Oklahoma Voice reports she is a nurse and that she had not previously held elected office.

sources.title: N'Kiyla Thomas wins Democratic nomination for U.S. Senate in Oklahoma
Democrat Jasmine Thomas hopes lived experience will propel her to Oklahoma Senate seat
